topic.title: A new title instead of a raise
topic.claim: A fancier title is what a company hands you when it doesn't want to hand you money.
topic.moment: You asked for a hike, you got 'Senior' added to your designation and a pat on the back.

turn.believed: The promotion means they value you and the money will follow.
turn.actually: The title cost them nothing and bought your silence for another year.

topic.because: Titles don't touch the salary budget, and they make you feel you've moved up. The company keeps the cost down and the loyalty up.
topic.payoff: A title you can't put on your next salary slip is a compliment, not a promotion.
topic.behaviour: Firms rename roles at appraisal time and defer the actual raise.
topic.mechanism: A title is free to give and feels like progress, so it replaces cash.
topic.send_to: the friend who just became a 'Lead' with no pay change
topic.why_now: hiring is tight and companies are freezing budgets but still need to hold people

score.why: Every office reader has gotten a title instead of a raise, and 'costs them nothing, buys your silence' is a real turn, not a nod.

cover.headline: A new 'Senior' is what they hand you instead of [money].
cover.sub: You asked for a raise and walked out a 'Senior'.

paragraphs: You walked in asking for a hike. You walked out a 'Senior' with the exact same salary.
slides.why_swipe: Reader wants to see how the 'Senior' trick actually plays out.

paragraphs: The manager slides it across like good news: new designation, more ownership, "we really see you."
Your bank balance doesn't notice. Same number, longer name in the email signature.
slides.why_swipe: If the money didn't move, what did they actually give you?

paragraphs: You tell yourself the money follows the title. Next cycle pakka.
But a raise lands in your account every month, for as long as you stay. A word added to your designation lands nowhere.
slides.why_swipe: So why does the free option beat a real raise for them?

paragraphs: Budgets are frozen and they still can't afford to watch you walk, so the cheapest thing in the room becomes a title.
**It costs nothing to print and buys another year of your loyalty.**
slides.why_swipe: There's a way to test whether your shiny new title is worth anything.

paragraphs: Here's the test. Open a job site and type in your new title. Watch the offers come back based on what you do, not the word on your card.
**A title you can't put on your next salary slip is a compliment, not a promotion.**

end.save: Keep it for the week they add a word to your title and nothing to your account.
end.send: Send to the friend who just became a 'Lead' with the same pay.
